title: gonolobus haitiensis
intro: Gonolobus haitiensis, commonly known as Haitian milk vine, is a plant species within the Apocynaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Gonolobus haitiensis include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides and iridoid compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
